films.title: TO THE BONE
films.description: Venue Skateboards' tenth full-length celebrates 32 years of Richmond skateboarding in a 36-minute intergenerational scene film. Fourteen named section riders anchor a deep 29-name friends montage, with landmarks including SunTrust and the Richmond Coliseum carrying the shop's history into a new generation.
